basic_info.chief_complaint: My lower front teeth are sore and my gums are swollen and painful, so I need to get checked out.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: My lower front teeth are sore and my gums are swollen and painful, so I need to get checked out.

oral_examination.oral_examination: The neck of the entire mouth is covered with a large amount of calculus, the gums are congested, red and swollen, the oral hygiene is poor, bleeding occurs on probing, and deep periodontal pockets are detected. The gingival papillae in the anterior teeth were swollen and soft, and gray-white ulcers were seen at the gingival margin (see the periodontal record sheet for details). 48 38 No teeth were visible. The blind pocket covered the tooth surface, and the probe could explore the tooth surface. There were many food residues in the blind pocket, and the gums were soft, red and swollen. CBCT showed that the alveolar bone was resorbed horizontally throughout the mouth. Attachment loss averages 1.5-2mm

treatment_plan.definitive: Systemic periodontal treatment is recommended. 48 38 Rinse and apply medicine, remove after anti-inflammation
treatment_plan.notes: Pay attention to oral hygiene and return to the clinic regularly.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 4% articaine local infiltration anesthesia, supragingival scaling, massive bleeding, subgingival scaling, root planing, alternate irrigation with hydrogen peroxide and normal saline, and application of Palio. 88 For local pericoronal irrigation, use Paglio.
